evidence.detail: In the hash-matched census bundle the reportSubscribe component calls this route to load its table rows and page_info.total_number. Creating, editing, deleting and exporting a subscription each go through their own separate routes, so listing carries no write side effect.

The recovered frontend builder sends only an integer app_id and the fixed subject "$lib_version", carries no pagination, and the response is consumed as a read-only dictionary of string arrays. No mutation control flow reaches this route.
A minimum single-page request returned HTTP 200 with a semantically successful empty envelope, with no confirmation step, no layout update and no success toast.

The recovered frontend builder proves five top-level fields and seven filter subkeys, and the caller slices the returned list locally. Listing and slicing are read behaviour; no write control flow invokes this route.
A minimum first-page request returned HTTP 200 with a semantically successful empty data.list envelope, with no confirmation step and no modification feedback.

In hash-matched MasterkeyAd-BgxTfClc.js, the Group component invokes this route on mount, search and page changes with date_list, filters, order_by, page and page_size; it assigns response list rows to the report table and page_info.total_number to the paginator. The route has no mutation feedback or write continuation.

In hash-matched ReportCommonHeader-Ck1C9MQA.js, opening the saved-report dialog loads this route, renders response list rows and page_info.total_number, and reloads it on page or filter changes. Deletion uses the separate /datamanageconfig/report/update/ route with is_delete=1.

In hash-matched NewReportCenter-Dxgo5EkI.js, MetricsPanel loads this route alongside the normal and owned custom-metric lists, assigns its response list to the shared-metric collection, merges it into the displayed metric catalog, and paginates the merged rows locally. Delete and share mutations use separate routes.

In hash-matched GeneralImportAd-CKb38unY.js, the Ad component invokes this route on mount, search, sort and page changes, assigns response list rows to the table, and consumes page_info.total_number in the paginator. app_id comes from AppSelect and ad_platform from the frontend's finite media-platform options; blank selectors are converted to undefined. Upload and delete use separate routes.
